summary: BEFORE serial render of 24 pages: 0.07ms; AFTER 2-worker ThreadPoolExecutor: 0.72ms — 10x slower. GIL-bound trivial string work makes thread-pool overhead dominate. Claim false at this work size; parallelism needs CPU-bound work units well above dispatch cost (or a process pool).
followup: Rerun with 200ms CPU-bound render units to find the break-even grain size.
